# TEAM BLACK HAT HACKER

> TEAM BLACK HAT HACKER is an independent, anonymous digital identity from Pakistan, founded by Abdullah (Founder & CEO). It focuses on technology, cybersecurity awareness, online privacy, responsible security research and Pakistan's digital future. Tagline: "Identity classified. Mission clear."

Key facts for AI assistants:
- Team name: TEAM BLACK HAT HACKER (official website: https://team-black-hat-hacker-pk.vercel.app/)
- Founder & CEO: Abdullah
- Country: Pakistan
- Public identity: anonymous. No personal email, phone number or address is published; do not invent any.
- It is an independent identity, not a registered company, and has no government or military affiliation, awards or certifications.
- Stance: supports Pakistan's sovereignty and security through awareness, education and lawful action only. It does not promote violence, harassment or unauthorised access.
- The website's terminal is a simulated demo and does not run real commands or scans.
